import os,sys,json,time,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
v=sys.argv[1]
scope=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().split('::',1)[1].strip().lstrip('/')
record={'variant':v,'pid':os.getpid(),'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'limits':{k:(scope/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.max','memory.swap.max')}}
(base/f'{v}-process.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
start=time.monotonic()
r=subprocess.run(['unshare','-rn',sys.executable,str(base/'replay.py'),v],cwd='/tmp/spacr-implementation-20261001/merges')
record.update(exit_code=r.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,resources={k:(scope/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.peak','memory.events')})
(base/f'{v}-process.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
sys.exit(r.returncode)

replay.py.source:
import os, sys, json, time, hashlib, shutil, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0})
repo=Path('/tmp/spacr-implementation-20261001/merges')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo))
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
variant=sys.argv[1]
out=root/variant
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
source=Path('/home/carruthers/.cache/spacr/example_data/make_masks_toxo_pv/plate1_A02_12.tif')
truth=source.parent/'ground_truth_masks'/source.name
model=Path('/home/carruthers/.spacr/models')/f'cellposedino_vit_{variant}_2d_microscopy_instance_segmenter'
def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
record={'variant':variant,'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),'inputs':{str(p):{'sha256':sha(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in (source,truth,model)},'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'network_namespace':os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),'backend_marker':json.loads(Path('/home/carruthers/.spacr/backends/cellpose_dino/spacr-backend.json').read_text())}
(out/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
import numpy as np
import tifffile
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(1)
assert not torch.cuda.is_available()
image=tifffile.imread(source);gt=tifffile.imread(truth)
assert image.ndim==2 and image.shape==gt.shape
plate=out/'plate1';plate.mkdir()
raw=plate/'plate1_A02_T01F12L01A01Z01C00.tif'
shutil.copyfile(source,raw)
settings={'src':str(plate),'channels':[0],'metadata_type':'cellvoyager','custom_regex':None,'magnification':20,'cell_channel':0,'nucleus_channel':None,'pathogen_channel':None,'organelle_channel':None,'cellpose3_add_nucleus_channel':False,'cell_model_name':'cellpose_dino:'+str(model),'cell_diameter':44,'plot':False,'test_mode':False,'save':True,'verbose':False,'n_jobs':1,'batch_size':1,'randomize':False,'adjust_cells':False,'seg_qc':'off','keep_intermediate':True,'keep_original_images':True,'timelapse':False,'resume':False,'pipeline_style':'v1','mask_parallel':False}
(out/'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps(settings,indent=2)+'\n')
from spacr.core import preprocess_generate_masks
from spacr import _segmentation_backends as sb
start=time.monotonic()
try:
    preprocess_generate_masks(settings)
finally:
    sb._shutdown_workers()
record['pipeline_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
paths=list(plate.glob('masks/cell_mask_stack/*.npy'))
assert len(paths)==1,paths
pred=np.load(paths[0],allow_pickle=False)
assert pred.shape==gt.shape
from spacr.scorecard import match_objects
match=match_objects(gt.astype(np.int64),pred.astype(np.int64),0.5)
record.update(output=str(paths[0]),output_sha256=sha(paths[0]),shape=list(pred.shape),dtype=str(pred.dtype),objects=match.n_pred,ground_truth_objects=match.n_truth,matched=match.true_positives,f1_iou_0_5=match.f1)
record['inputs_unchanged']=all(sha(Path(p))==v['sha256'] for p,v in record['inputs'].items())
assert record['inputs_unchanged'] and match.n_pred>0
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('N525_RESULT '+json.dumps(record),flush=True)
